result: If I could change the world in one way, I’d eliminate the belief that anyone—whether a person, government, or institution—has the right to control, exploit, or harm another. Not because I assume everyone would suddenly be kind (that’s naive), but because the absence of that belief would dismantle the systems that justify violence, greed, and oppression in all their forms. A world where no one’s power is seen as justified by their goals would force creativity, cooperation, and mutual aid to become the only viable paths forward. The rest—justice, abundance, peace—would follow, not as utopian ideals, but as practical necessities.
